title: Reading Drill — Testing a shallow pond ramp — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a shallow pond ramp — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The wildlife centre staff in Ravensmere received an old report about animals reaching the edge but being unable to leave the water. The report compared successful exits, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the daytime observations rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered nine weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include fluctuating water height. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a rougher ramp surface as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
